companies.name: Wall Street Journal
companies.context: Published a viral article titled 'Companies Are Desperately Seeking Storytellers' by Katie Dayton that sparked the episode's main discussion.

companies.name: Google
companies.context: Cited for a Google Cloud job ad seeking a 'customer storytelling manager' and publishing a Vertex AI/Lowe's case study article.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.context: Cited for hiring a senior director of narrative and storytelling in its Security Organization; Steve Clayton served as Microsoft's chief storyteller from 2010 to 2021. Satya Nadella quoted as saying he is 'happy to be a leaser' worth $80 billion.

companies.name: Vanta
companies.context: Mentioned as one of the companies actively hiring for a storyteller role.

companies.name: Notion
companies.context: Merged its communications, social media, and influencer functions into a single 10-person 'storytelling team.'

companies.name: Apple
companies.context: Cited as historically a great storyteller but currently lacking in that area because Tim Cook is an elite operator rather than a narrative-driven CEO. Guy Kawasaki credited as an early Apple marketing evangelist.

companies.name: Nike
companies.context: Briefly mentioned as representative of the brand strategy and brand identity era of marketing in the 1980s and 1990s.

companies.name: Anduril
companies.context: Praised for its 'Don't Work at Anduril' ad campaign, called one of the best campaigns of 2025; Palmer Luckey makes a cameo but the ad carries weight without him.

companies.name: Astronomer
companies.context: Highlighted for its 'Thank You for Your Interest in Astronomer' crisis-response campaign featuring Gwyneth Paltrow, called a campaign that will be studied in 10 years.

companies.name: Ramp
companies.context: Mentioned for a well-executed Super Bowl commercial featuring Saquon Barkley and the Eagles win timing; also referenced for a SORA-generated satirical video about Sam Altman.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.context: Launched a new ChatGPT image generation model that is 4x faster; announced hiring of a Google executive to lead M&A; chief comms officer Hannah Wong is departing at end of January 2026.

companies.name: Palantir
companies.context: CEO Alex Karp briefly mentioned as an example of a founder who is an elite storyteller and would be a strong Joe Rogan-style CEO.

companies.name: Ford
companies.context: Taking a $19.5 billion writedown on its EV business; lost $13 billion on EVs since 2023 and roughly $50,000 per EV sold last year; scrapping the all-electric F-150 Lightning and pivoting to gas and hybrids.

companies.name: Paramount
companies.context: Jared Kushner's Affinity was financing Paramount's bid for Warner Bros. Discovery before withdrawing due to changed deal dynamics.

companies.name: Warner Bros. Discovery
companies.context: Subject of an ongoing takeover battle; Kushner's Affinity withdrew from financing a bid, reshaping the deal landscape.

companies.name: Affinity
companies.context: Jared Kushner's firm withdrew from the Warner Bros. Discovery takeover bid, citing changed investment dynamics.

companies.name: Tesla
companies.context: Briefly noted as the exception among Mag 7 companies, with the others said to have reasonable valuations.

companies.name: Meta
companies.context: Cited as having discussed AI's benefits for advertising in detail; hosts agreed advertising is a clear AI beneficiary.

companies.name: C.H. Robinson
companies.context: Mentioned as an example of a traditional company pointing to AI and agentic workflows for improved efficiency.

companies.name: Broadcom
companies.context: Referenced alongside Oracle as an AI input company that the market scrutinized diligently this past week, cited as evidence the market is behaving rationally about AI.

companies.name: Oracle
companies.context: Market skepticism about its future RPO cited as a sign of rational market behavior around AI valuations; people dunking on Oracle seen as appropriate scrutiny rather than bubble signs.

companies.name: Amazon
companies.context: Described as one of the largest US advertisers; aired its first holiday TV ad on October 13th, earlier than typical.

companies.name: Walmart
companies.context: Running holiday TV ads featuring a Dr. Seuss-inspired world with Walter Goggins as the Grinch.

companies.name: Target
companies.context: Bringing back its 'Chris Kay' jolly Christmas character from a 2024 campaign in this year's holiday ads.

companies.name: National Retail Federation
companies.context: Projecting that 2025 US holiday retail sales will surpass $1 trillion for the first time.

companies.name: Lowe's
companies.context: Featured in a Google Cloud storytelling team article about how Vertex AI enables interactive shopping experiences.

companies.name: Bucco Capital
companies.context: Published a note arguing AI is not a bubble, citing real business impact in coding, tech support, and advertising, and rational market scrutiny of AI input companies.

people.name: Katie Dayton
people.context: Wrote the viral WSJ article 'Companies Are Desperately Seeking Storytellers' that served as the episode's main talking point.

people.name: Steve Clayton
people.context: Held the title of Microsoft's 'chief storyteller' from 2010 to June 2021, cited as evidence the term predates its current trend.

people.name: Guy Kawasaki
people.context: Cited as an early Silicon Valley storyteller who popularized evangelism marketing while promoting the Macintosh in 1984.

people.name: Palmer Luckey
people.context: Cited as an archetypal 'Joe Rogan CEO' elite storyteller-founder; his response to a WSJ article about an Anduril test site fire praised as great narrative framing.

people.name: Elon Musk
people.context: Named as one of the most elite storyteller-founders whose narrative abilities create massive company value.

people.name: Alex Karp
people.context: Named alongside Elon and Palmer as an elite founder-storyteller who would be a strong performer in a long-form podcast format.

people.name: Avi Schiffman
people.context: Praised for a billboard saturation campaign estimated at $1–2 million that made him a household name on the coasts, cited as evidence that billboard spend has increasing returns to scale.

people.name: Sam Altman
people.context: Teased the new ChatGPT image model launch with a photo; referenced as a subject of SORA-generated satirical content.

people.name: Hannah Wong
people.context: OpenAI's first CCO is departing the company at the end of January 2026 after guiding it through ChatGPT's launch, regulatory scrutiny, and multiple controversies.

people.name: Jared Kushner
people.context: His firm Affinity withdrew from financing Paramount's bid for Warner Bros. Discovery, citing changed investment dynamics.

people.name: Gwyneth Paltrow
people.context: Featured in Astronomer's 'Thank You for Your Interest in Astronomer' crisis-response campaign, considered one of 2025's best corporate storytelling moments.

people.name: Jim Farley
people.context: Announced Ford's $19.5 billion EV writedown and pivot to gas and hybrid vehicles, scrapping the all-electric F-150 Lightning.

people.name: Tim Cook
people.context: Described as an elite operator but not a 'Joe Rogan CEO' storyteller, cited as the reason Apple's storytelling has weakened despite strong business performance.

people.name: Satya Nadella
people.context: Quoted as saying 'I'm happy to be a leaser' for $80 billion, cited as a memorable corporate storytelling moment of 2025.

people.name: Stefan Sagmeister
people.context: A 2014 observation by Sagmeister was cited: it's the non-storytellers who suddenly want to be called storytellers.

people.name: Walter Goggins
people.context: Stars as the Grinch in a Dr. Seuss-inspired Walmart holiday TV campaign.

people.name: Eric Zaworski
people.context: Shared an observation about the Wall Street Journal storyteller article, noting that those who would crush the storyteller role rarely get hired for it.

topics.name: Corporate Storyteller Hiring Trend
topics.summary: A WSJ article reported LinkedIn job postings including 'storyteller' doubled year-over-year to 50,000+ in marketing. Hosts argued that hiring a storyteller is less valuable than having a founder-CEO who is a natural storyteller, coining the term 'Joe Rogan CEO.' One breakthrough campaign is worth 10,000 posts.

topics.name: Joe Rogan CEO Concept
topics.summary: Host coined the term 'Joe Rogan CEO' to describe founder-CEOs like Elon Musk, Alex Karp, and Palmer Luckey who can command attention for hours in long-form formats and create massive brand value through narrative alone.

topics.name: Best Corporate Campaigns of 2025
topics.summary: Hosts highlighted Anduril's 'Don't Work at Anduril' ad, Astronomer's Gwyneth Paltrow crisis-response campaign, Ramp's Super Bowl commercial with Saquon Barkley, and Avi Schiffman's billboard saturation strategy as standout storytelling moments of the year.

topics.name: Ford EV Business Writedown
topics.summary: Ford announced a $19.5 billion charge on its EV business, scrapped the all-electric F-150 Lightning, and is pivoting back to gas-powered cars and hybrids. Ford has lost $13 billion on EVs since 2023, including ~$50,000 per EV sold last year.

topics.name: Kushner/Affinity Withdraws from Warner Bros. Bid
topics.summary: Jared Kushner's Affinity pulled out of financing Paramount's bid for Warner Bros. Discovery, citing changed deal dynamics. The takeover battle is seen as reshaping the entertainment industry.

topics.name: ChatGPT New Image Generation Model
topics.summary: OpenAI released a new flagship image generation model powering ChatGPT Images, described as 4x faster with precise editing capabilities and preset style options to reduce prompting friction.

topics.name: AI Is Not a Bubble
topics.summary: Bucco Capital argued AI is not a bubble, pointing to real business impact in coding, tech support, and advertising; hyperscalers have more demand than supply. Market skepticism of companies like Oracle and Broadcom cited as evidence of rational, not euphoric, pricing.

topics.name: Holiday Advertising Spend 2025
topics.summary: Holiday retail sales expected to surpass $1 trillion for the first time. TV ad spend hit $1.47 billion over nine weeks, up 13% YoY; digital retail ad spend reached $5.8 billion in the first week of November, up 4%. Amazon kicked off holiday ads on October 13th.

topics.name: OpenAI Leadership Changes
topics.summary: OpenAI hired a Google executive to lead M&A and announced the departure of its first chief communications officer, Hannah Wong, effective end of January 2026.

key_claims: LinkedIn job postings including the term 'storyteller' doubled year-over-year to over 50,000 listings in marketing and 20,000+ in media and communications.
Ford took a $19.5 billion writedown on its EV business, lost $13 billion on EVs since 2023, and lost approximately $50,000 per EV sold last year.
Ford is scrapping the all-electric F-150 Lightning entirely and pivoting to gas-powered cars and hybrids.
U.S. holiday retail sales are projected to surpass $1 trillion in 2025 for the first time, up from $980 billion last year.
Holiday TV ad spend reached $1.47 billion over nine weeks, a 13% jump year-over-year.
Retailers spent $5.8 billion on digital ads from November 1–7, a 4% increase from last year.
Avi Schiffman spent an estimated $1–2 million on a billboard saturation campaign and became a household name on the coasts.
Billboards may have increasing returns to scale — buying 200 creates unavoidable awareness while buying two creates none.
Microsoft had a 'chief storyteller' role as far back as 2010, held by Steve Clayton through June 2021.
One great campaign is worth 10,000 posts for companies that lack a 'Joe Rogan CEO.'
The new ChatGPT image generation model is 4x faster than its predecessor.
Jared Kushner's Affinity withdrew from the Warner Bros. Discovery takeover bid, citing changed investment dynamics.
OpenAI's first chief communications officer Hannah Wong is departing at the end of January 2026.
Gen AI increases content output volume but has not produced an exponential increase in great ideas.
Mag 7 companies minus Tesla have reasonable valuations and hyperscalers have more AI demand than they can handle.
